solution_families.label: Targeted mechanism
solution_families.description: Optional lens for a mechanism confined to one evidenced consumer or failure path. Omit it when it is only a smaller wording of another option.

solution_families.label: Guarded mechanism
solution_families.description: Optional lens for a distinct mechanism whose defining behavior is an evidenced boundary check or defense against a specific recurrence path. Extra validation alone does not make a distinct option.

solution_families.label: Multi-path mechanism
solution_families.description: Optional lens for one mechanism proven across at least two independent consumers or failure paths. Shared or canonical abstractions require evidence references for each path.

prompt_guardrails.selection_principle: Family IDs are compatibility labels, not a breadth or quality ranking. Generate only genuinely distinct mechanisms and select by causal coverage.
prompt_guardrails.note: These adjectives are banned from stage prompts unless they appear only through injected taxonomy text. They steer toward expedient solutions rather than correct ones. Use the solution-family labels above to express tradeoffs.
